purpose: Header OWS: an Access-Control-Expose-Headers value padded with optional whitespace is still a wildcard (old normalization missed it).

groundTruth.rationale: RFC 7230 optional whitespace is not part of the field value; the header exposes every response header to any origin.

limitations: Observation mode: the fixture is a synthetic HTTP observation object, not a live request or a real target.
The case proves the declared DAST check evaluates as stated on this observation; it does not prove exploitability.
